text:
maggie: quick heads-up — our preflight job started failing on some routing config saves this morning. seen it twice on staging when arrays of header matchers are present.

alex: ugh, saw that too. error from the validator: "mixed types in header matchers not allowed". looks like ajv schema is interpreting `value` as string or array depending on the example.

cheng: can you paste the failing snippet?

maggie: here: ```yaml
- match: headers
  name: x-tenant
  value: [acme, beta]
  type: exact
```

alex: our schema currently has `value: string` for header matcher. old-editor used to let an array slip through and the runtime handled it (it normalized). new strict schema rejects it.

leo: runtime accepting both was convenient but also confusing. we should pick one canonical shape. prefer array? single string feels simpler for authors.

cheng: thinking: keep schema strict (string) but add a pre-save transform in Console to normalize arrays -> comma-separated string, and warn. That keeps runtime stable and surfaces the suggestion.

sara: +1 for a UX hint. But we need regression tests so console <> api roundtrip doesn't lose info. if user pasted an array intentionally we should surface that as a breaking change in diff preview.

maggie: related: AJV error doesn't report the exact path cleanly. It points to /properties/rules/items/0 but not the header name. We should improve validation errors to include the field path and a human-friendly message.

alex: agree. Proposal: validation error format: `{field_path, severity, suggestion}`. severity: info/warn/error. suggestion: example fix. This lets Console render inline suggestions with a one-click autofix.

ci-bot: build 1342: preflight-validate FAILED for branch feat/schema-tighten (see https://ci.internal/r/1342)

cheng: perfect, we can wire the ci error to create a support link in the Console diff. For autofix UX, we can implement two modes: soft-fix (patch in UI, user confirms save) and strict-fail (CI gate).

leo: who owns the soft-fix PR? I can take a spike for the console side to detect array values and show a toast + suggestion.

maggie: can you also add a test harness that fuzzes header matcher shapes and runs ajv + runtime normalization? we had an incident where a surprising shape made routing fallback to default bucket.

leo: yes — I'll add a tiny fuzzer that generates string/array/null combos and asserts roundtrip equivalence or explicit warning.

alex: on the API side I'll add the `{field_path,severity,suggestion}` wrapper around ajv errors and a small mapper to turn ajv paths into YAML line numbers when possible.

cheng: one more thing — we need to document deprecation: if we change canonical shape we must support a 6-month migration and emit deprecation warnings via telemetry and console banner.

sara: agree on telemetry. add a metric routed_config.deprecation_warning_emitted with tags {org,project,rule_type}. ops needs that to coordinate Dedicated customers.

maggie: ok plan: alex + cheng do API error shape + line mapping, leo does Console autofix UI + fuzzer tests, sara wires telemetry + doc note. I'll file a tracking ticket and assign owners.

alex: filing PR to normalize ajv errors into structured payload. link incoming.

leo: starting spike now, will post small demo gif in this thread when done. :eyes:

maggie: thanks all — want soft-fix in 2-week sprint and CI-gate change in 4 weeks. if blockers crop up we'll revert the schema change.

ci-bot: ticket created: INF-2894 "routing-schema: normalize header matcher shapes + structured validation errors"
